prompt: Summarize the following meeting notes in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: During the project kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics RFP response, the team outlined a three-phase rollout plan starting with discovery in April and a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May, contingent on the availability of two part-time coordinators from the client’s operations team.
